name: Fujimura Takako
source:
28 years old, the daughter of the chairman of Reiki Girls' Academy.

She came to the academy as acting chairman around the time Kengo began training girls. She wants to find out what Kengo is doing behind the scenes and use it to set up a prostitution ring for executives.

She's just as bad as her father, but has a gentle and kind appearance.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20121105072348/http://slpr.sakura.ne.jp/DEEP2/]the official site,archived[/url]]
